Title: 3 Food Coma Myths - What Actually Causes That Afternoon Slump

Description:
It's not the turkey, it's not just being tired, and it's not a willpower problem. A blood sugar crash, an immune response to fat, and a dip in your body clock — the real reasons you crash after lunch.

Lead with protein and fiber, keep fried and heavy food to a smaller portion, and beat the 2 PM dip with a short nap or bright light.
